name: agroshop
description: Offline fertilizer & pesticides shop management — React + Vite, Express, SQLite. Runs on one PC.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
